No article morpheme stands anywhere in this verse, so each written *the* is supplied to the construct noun it stands before (rule 29): *the rest*, *the acts*, *the book*, *the kings*.

The *they* of *behold they are written* goes to the suffix on `הִנֵּה` rather than to the participle, since a pronominal morpheme is present to carry it (rule 18); the participle keeps *are written* with the construction-supplied copula (rule 20).

`עַל` takes the *in* the ASV writes in its book-of-the-chronicles idiom (rule 11); `וִיהוּדָה` is coordinated under the same *of*, so the waw takes only its *and* and no second *of* is written to place.
